summary: Official Bihar BhuNaksha and Araria district land-record evidence was found. The public viewer's current JavaScript/configuration was inspected and its public hierarchy, extent and WMS map routes were exercised anonymously. No safe native parcel identity plus full polygon geometry response was obtained, so runtime remains held.
queryOutcomes: Separate English and Hindi discovery queries, exact text and actual result URLs are recorded in city-11465-araria.json.
requestOutcomes: TLS-verified GET retrieved the official viewer, indexmain.jsp, config.js and index.js. POST /rest/Levels/ListsAfterLevel with state=10, level=3, codes=07,01,01, and hasmap=true returned Araria circle mauzas plus SS/RS/CS survey types. POST /rest/MapInfo/getVVVVExtentGeoref with state=10, gisLevels=07,01,01,0001,SS,00,00, and srs=0 returned HTTP 200 JSON with EPSG:32645, extent xmin=553447.7336301489, ymin=2895291.5410998235, xmax=555420.316730149, ymax=2897614.859199824, and gisCode SS07010100011510000. WMS GetMap for VILLAGE_MAP returned HTTP 200 PNG. WMS GetCapabilities returned HTTP 500. No login, credentials, private token, CAPTCHA/Cloudflare bypass, unsafe fields, or TLS exception was used.

HTTP 200 anonymous POST; returned Araria circle mauzas including Pokharia(151), and SS/RS/CS survey options.
HTTP 200 anonymous POST; returned EPSG:32645 projected extent and stable gisCode for one mapped mauza/survey selection.
HTTP 200 anonymous GetMap; PNG map image returned for the bounded Pokharia extent. Map imagery is not retained as a parcel sample.
HTTP 200 official district page directs users to BiharBhumi land records; custodian/procedure evidence, not parcel geometry.

attemptedRoutes.outcome: HTTP 200 official state portal lists Bhu-Naksha and land-record services; no anonymous parcel vector response.

scopeLimits: The exact WUP point [26.1303349346033, 87.4552070728849] was preserved; no exact-point hit or miss inference was made.
The tested extent is one Araria circle mauza (Pokharia) and is not evidence of citywide coverage.
The WMS response is raster map imagery; no full parcel polygon was retrieved or retained.

The ScalarDatahandler plot-detail routes were not used because their UI purpose may return unsafe record fields; no owner, address, titleholder, contact, tax/account or personal fields were requested or retained.
The official portal's existence and mapped hierarchy do not establish anonymous vector access, native ID semantics, or complete Araria municipal coverage.
Packet completion records research status only; it does not qualify or admit a runtime adapter. Independent serial review remains required.
